SessionResult.description:
Game SDK SessionResult (GAME_SDK §10), converted from packages/game-core/schema/SessionResult.json (JSON Schema
2020-12 generated from the game-core Zod schema). It keeps camelCase because it is shared byte-for-byte with
@margdarshak/game-core and replayed by the score verifier (API_SPEC §1.1). Conversion: `anyOf [X, {type: null}]`
is written as `type: [X, 'null']`; sub-objects are the named components SessionScore, Finding, Evidence and

info.description:
Contract for the Margdarshak core (FastAPI). Every endpoint carries its API-xx ID from
`docs/00-overview/PROJECT_BRIEF.md` in `x-api-id`. Endpoints marked `x-proposed: true` are
additions proposed by the engineering bible (auth, helper links, identity, payment hand-off,
DigiLocker) and are listed as inconsistencies for the PROJECT_BRIEF owner to ratify.

Independent prototype by team Chanakya. Not affiliated with MoRTH, NIC or any State
Transport Department. Uses simulated government data. Margdarshak never collects an Aadhaar
number, OTP, biometrics or government fees.

Conventions (see docs/03-engineering/API_SPEC.md):
* Errors use RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`.
* Writes accept an `Idempotency-Key` header (UUIDv7 recommended); replays within 24 h return the stored response.
* Lists use opaque cursor pagination (`cursor`, `limit`, `next_cursor`).
* Rate limits are announced with `RateLimit-Policy` and `RateLimit` headers; 429 carries `Retry-After`.
* All timestamps are RFC 3339 in UTC; all dates are ISO 8601 calendar dates in Asia/Kolkata.
* Money is integer **paise** (`amount_paise`, e.g. 70000 = Rs 700), always computed from the tenant rule pack (`fees.json`, unit paise); no literals.

post.description:
Workflows tasks never hold business logic and never query Postgres directly. Each durable
task calls the steps it needs here (case_clock_sweep: clock.plan_pages then clock_batch ->
clock.fire_batch); steps are idempotent by their inputs so a Workflows retry is safe.

* `clock.plan_pages` args `{sweep_id, tenants, as_of, after, limit}` -> `{as_of, events: [{case_id, type, due_on}], next_cursor}`.
  `as_of` is the server's IST date (a caller date later than the server date is ignored, EC-15).
* `clock.fire_batch` args `{sweep_id, as_of, page, event_keys[]}` -> `{fired, skipped_opt_out, failed, already_fired}`
  (plus `deferred_quiet_hours`, `deferred_daily_cap`, `skipped_cancelled`, `not_due`), idempotent per event key `caseId:type:dueOn`.
  A batch with a retryable delivery failure answers 503 after committing the rest, so the task retries only what was not delivered.

Clip pipeline (clip-pipeline `CLIP_INGEST_STEPS` / `CLIP_FINALIZE_STEPS`; idempotency key `clipId:step:version[:r<round>]`):
* `clip.get` args `{clip_id, version}` -> `{clip}` (clip.json, server-only fields included; never sent to clients).
* `clip.propose_windows` args `{clip_id, version}` -> `{proposals: [], skipped: true}`. A stub in P2 (D8): no unaudited frame goes to a model.
* `clip.open_review` args `{clip_id, version}` -> `{status}`: moves the clip to `proposed` and posts the signed `md/clip-ready` envelope to n8n W08.
* `clip.agreement` args `{clip_id, version, round}` -> `{accepted, needs_third_rater, reasons, final_hazards}` from the two stored ratings (compute service `/clip/agreement`); accepted moves the clip to `rated`.
* `clip.request_adjudication` args `{clip_id, version, round}` -> `{status}`: moves the clip to `adjudication` and notifies the curators; the run ends.
* `clip.blur_audit_check` args `{clip_id, version}` -> `{passed, issues}` against the stored audit and the published rendition's sha256.
* `clip.delete_raw` args `{clip_id, version}` -> `{object_keys, deleted_at, on_time, deadline}` (RawDeletionRecord, audit-logged; MD-218).
* `clip.publish_manifest` args `{clip_id, version}` -> `{status, bank_digest, client_digest}`: publishes the clip and the manifests.
* `clip.recompute_difficulty` args `{clip_id, version}` -> `{difficulty: {curator, empirical, n_takers}}`.
* `clip.register_generated` (clip_generate, ADR-0013) args `{scene_id, scene_revision, batch_id, raw_key, raw_sha256, raw_bytes, duration_ms, facts, generation, flash, ...}` -> `{clip_id, version, status, replayed}`:
  records the generated video on the ai_generated clip of that scene revision and batch (the one generateClip created, or a new one); idempotent per `sceneId:revision:batchId`.
  For ai_generated clips `clip.blur_audit_check` checks the synthetic review instead, and `clip.delete_raw` is a logged no-op (no raw footage).

Field study (RW-4 `nightly_stats`):
* `study.export_csv` args `{frozen_at?}` -> `{tenant, files: {"sessions.csv": <csv text>, "sessions_alt.csv": ..., "raters.csv": <csv text or null>}, sha256: {<file>: <hex>}, summary, omitted: [<file names with no rows, e.g. raters.csv before any rater agreement>]}`; `GET /internal/study/exports/{file}` serves the same files individually.
* `stats.field_study_publish` args `{as_of, numbers, stdout, script_sha256, prereg_hash}` -> `{as_of, published}`: stores what `field-kit/nazar_stats.mjs` printed, unmodified, for API-71.

Session debrief fan-out (RW-3 `debrief_fanout`, MD-311):
* `debrief.backfill` args `{since?, limit?}` -> `{pending, built, ai}`: builds and stores the debrief card of checked sessions
  (last 7 days by default) whose holder allows AI and that have no stored card; a stored card is never rebuilt, so retries are safe.
  A provider 429 or timeout leaves the card unstored and answers 503 `ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE` so the task retries with backoff.

Auth: service bearer (one of the API's `INTERNAL_BEARER_TOKENS`; the workflow service sends it as `INTERNAL_BEARER_TOKEN`) plus the `Margdarshak-Signature` HMAC.
The step result is returned both under `result` and flattened at the top level (the Workflows client reads the top level).

get.description:
Get a ticket from `POST /v1/voice/ticket`, open the socket, and send
`{type: "hello", v: 1, locale, screen, caseId?, token: <ticket>}` as the first frame. Client frames: `VoiceClientMessage` (JSON control) and binary 16-bit PCM 16 kHz mono
audio. Server frames: `VoiceServerMessage` (JSON) and binary 24 kHz PCM audio.
Max session 10 minutes (Gemini Live connection lifetime); 10 min/user/month on the
free plan. The agent can navigate and fill non-sensitive fields inside Margdarshak
only; it never submits, pays or books on Sarathi.

Authentication is the single-use ticket in the hello frame (browsers cannot set headers on a
WebSocket, and cookies are not relied on), so the upgrade itself is anonymous; the tenant
comes from `state`. Without a valid ticket in the first frame (5 s) the server sends
`error` (`reason_key: voice.ticket_invalid`) and closes. With `lang=doi` the client sends
push-to-talk audio and a `stop` frame; the server answers with the Saaras transcript
(`transcript_in`, editable), and the confirmed `text` frame runs the turn; the reply is
Hindi speech with a reviewed Dogri caption when one exists (VOICE.md §3.3). `text` frames
work in every language and are the fallback when live audio is unavailable.
